nodes.description: Public string name of the UniswapExchange token.
Public string symbol of the UniswapExchange token.
Constant decimals value (18) used to scale mint/init amounts.
Total token supply set in the constructor.
Privileged owner address assigned from msg.sender in the constructor; gates every admin function.
Public balanceOf mapping mutated directly with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom, batchSend and _mints.
Public nested allowance mapping read and decremented without SafeMath in transferFrom and written in approve.
Private per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and compared in condition.
Private whitelist flag; addresses set by _mints bypass the condition() restrictions in ensure().
Private minimum sale amount configured by init and enforced by condition.
Private maximum sale amount configured by init and enforced by condition.
Private sale quota configured by init and enforced per-address by condition.
Address whitelisted inside ensure(); writable only by the owner through setTradeAddress.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address (0x7a25...) whitelisted in ensure() and pre-approved in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that forwards msg.sender to transferFrom.
Core transfer path: allowance check, ensure() whitelist check, and unchecked balance mutations.
Whitelist gate that returns true for owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale addresses and otherwise delegates to condition.
Sale-limit checker enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale on transfer amounts.
Public payable approve granting allowance to an arbitrary spender for msg.sender.
Owner-gated arbitrary delegatecall executing attacker-supplied code in the token context.
Arbitrary mint function gated by owner OR a hardcoded mystery address, also whitelisting the target.
Owner-gated initializer for the sale limits and quota.
Owner-gated batch transfer computing _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
Owner-gated setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure CREATE2 address derivation for the Uniswap pair of the token.
Constructor minting the entire supply to msg.sender and setting owner.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used for ownership checks, allowances and whitelist decisions.
a.delegatecall(b): arbitrary delegatecall on an attacker-supplied address and payload.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value executed without SafeMath (underflow risk).
balanceOf[_to] += _value executed without SafeMath (overflow risk).
uint total = _value * _tos.length executed without overflow protection.

_from parameter of transferFrom, the debited account.

tokenA parameter of pairFor.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards msg.sender into transferFrom as the sender argument.
transfer() delegates all work to transferFrom.
transferFrom calls ensure() before mutating balances.
ensure() calls condition() for non-whitelisted senders.
approve() writes allowance for msg.sender.
msg.sender indexes allowance[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
delegate() is gated only by msg.sender == owner.
delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall on user input.
The attacker-supplied address a becomes the delegatecall target.
The attacker-supplied bytes b become the delegatecall calldata.
owner state variable is the only guard for the delegatecall entrypoint.
_mints allows msg.sender to be owner or a hardcoded mystery address, enabling arbitrary minting.
_mints compares msg.sender against owner.
init() requires msg.sender == owner.
owner gate used inside init().
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner.
owner gate used inside batchSend().
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner.
owner gate used inside setTradeAddress().
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to msg.sender.
Constructor writes the owner state variable.
transferFrom subtracts _value from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
_from selects the balance slot debited by the unchecked subtraction.
_value is the unchecked subtrahend on balanceOf[_from].
balanceOf mapping is mutated by the unchecked subtraction.
transferFrom adds _value to balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
_to selects the balance slot credited by the unchecked addition.
_value is the unchecked addend on balanceOf[_to].
balanceOf mapping is mutated by the unchecked addition.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping during the unchecked decrement.
_value is subtracted from the allowance without SafeMath.
allowance mapping is mutated by the unchecked subtraction.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
_value is the multiplicand in the unchecked total computation.
_tos.length is the multiplier in the unchecked total computation.
canSale whitelist lets the sender bypass the condition() restrictions in ensure().
tradeAddress is unconditionally whitelisted inside ensure().
The UNI router constant is unconditionally whitelisted inside ensure().
_minSale is enforced against _value in condition().
_maxSale is enforced against _value in condition().
_saleNum is used as the sale quota in condition().
_onSaleNum[_from] is compared against _saleNum in condition().
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] without any overflow guard.
ensure() forwards _from into condition().
ensure() forwards _value into condition().
transferFrom passes _from into ensure() for whitelist evaluation.
transferFrom passes _to into ensure() for whitelist evaluation.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the token pair address.
The pairFor() result is stored in the local _UNI inside ensure().
_mints writes balanceOf[spender] with a scaled addedValue.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, creating a transfer whitelist entry.
init() assigns the scaled token amount to _minSale.
init() assigns the scaled maxToken amount to _maxSale.
init() assigns saleNum to _saleNum.
setTradeAddress() writes the new tradeAddress whitelist entry.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approve() uses msg.sender as the owner key of the allowance mapping.
approve() uses the _spender parameter as the allowance key.
approve() stores the _value parameter into the allowance mapping.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
batchSend reads and writes balanceOf for msg.sender and every recipient.
The local _UNI is compared with _from inside ensure().
transfer() passes its _to parameter down to transferFrom.
transfer() passes its _value parameter down to transferFrom.
The arbitrary delegatecall target executes in the token context and can re-enter the state-mutating transferFrom.
